## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **Heian-era Japanese Sānlùn (Mādhyamika) school bibliographic catalog**, by **Anen** 安遠 (Japanese, dates not preserved). The **Sānlùn** 三論 / *Sanron* school is the Japanese-Mādhyamika institutional successor to the Tang **Jízàng** 吉藏 (549–623) Sanron tradition. One of the **seven sectarian bibliographies** ([KR6s0125](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0125)–[KR6s0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0131)).
